summary:
Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any tests or code, and without committing.

Changes:
- monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs; coordinates are integer [start, stop] rows per dimension including the channel, computed in the original unpadded frame. Docstring updated (Yields and Note). set_rnd skips attributes whose names start with "__".
- monai/data/grid_dataset.py: new PatchIter (prepends the channel whole-dimension entry, normalizes start_pos with ensure_tuple, validates mode via NumpyPadMode at construction, delegates to iter_patch with copy_back off). GridPatchDataset(dataset, patch_iter, transform=None, with_coordinates=True) splits indices across workers with np.ceil, applies the transform to the patch alone, and yields patches or (patch, coords). Missing-len check raises NotImplementedError with the exact message, in __iter__. Removed the unused math import; PatchDataset docstring uses float instead of np.float.
- monai/data/__init__.py: exports PatchIter.
- docs/source/data.rst: PatchIter autodoc entry.
- tests/test_grid_dataset.py (new): test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_len.

Choices and caveats:
- The missing-len check happens at iteration time, not construction.
- Coordinate unpacking uses patch, coords, *_ = item, so a one-element generator fails when coordinates are requested.
- test_loading_array uses np.arange(16) images; this was inferred from the pinned values, not verified.
- set_determinism(1234) is called in setUp and again at the start of test_loading_array, as the spec requires.
- Lines over 120 characters remain only in get_valid_patch_size, which was not edited.

Status: unverified. The pytest run on tests/test_grid_dataset.py was not performed because the task prohibited running tests, so the pinned values and the two-worker behavior are untested.
